title: Battery, memory card and monitor handling
summary: Reconstructed from a 61 s demonstration video of a probable Canon EOS 60D: battery removal and return, SD card removal and return, top-control handling and articulated-monitor movement. Educational reconstruction; lever endpoints and electrical state are unresolved — follow the official manual for real operation.

steps.title: Identify the camera
steps.body: Inspect the body, attached capped lens, rear controls and underside as the demonstrator turns the camera. Probable EOS 60D; badge blurred.

steps.title: Open the battery cover
steps.body: Move the underside cover latch and swing the battery door open. The small latch travel and hinge angle are approximate.

steps.title: Release and withdraw the battery
steps.body: Move the retaining tab, then draw the battery out of the grip compartment. Hold it clear of the camera. LP-E6 compatibility follows the probable camera identity; the pack brand and printed markings are unreadable.
steps.caution: Hold the battery clear of the camera; contacts and markings are not modelled.

steps.title: Reinsert and close
steps.body: Return the battery to the compartment and close the underside door. Reinsertion is partly obscured at about 22–24 seconds.

steps.title: Open the card compartment
steps.body: Turn to the grip side and open the memory-card cover. The cover hinge geometry is approximate.

steps.title: Remove the SD card
steps.body: Press at the card slot, then withdraw the card and hold it clear. The short spring-release travel is inferred from the mechanism and the partly hidden hand movement.

steps.title: Return the SD card
steps.body: Guide the card into the same slot and press it into place. Card label, capacity, orientation details and insertion depth are simplified; follow the markings on the physical camera.

steps.title: Close the card cover
steps.body: Fold the card-compartment cover shut. The latch internals are not modeled.

steps.title: Handle the top control
steps.body: Follow the demonstrator's finger at the mode-dial and power-switch area. Lever motion is illustrative; the exact OFF/ON transition and selected mode cannot be read.

steps.title: Swing the monitor out
steps.body: Pull the rear monitor away from the body on its side hinge. The model uses a generic symbol, not a decoded camera message.

steps.title: Swivel and fold the monitor
steps.body: Rotate the extended monitor, then return it against the back of the body with its display facing outward. Angles and timing are approximate; do not force the physical hinge.
steps.caution: Do not force the physical hinge; angles and timing are approximate.

steps.title: Final control demonstration
steps.body: Follow the final movement near the top-left control area. The final switch position is obscured.
